text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono! Happy birthday to you! I'm<n>turning this
whole day into a party for<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Think of it as thanks for always<n>making amazing
food for me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Vanquishing evil requires the power<n>of justice! The
food you make is full<n>of nutrition, so it's perfect for
refueling!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You mean it? I'm so happy! I'll have<n>to make lots
and lots of food today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If you need power, I know just the<n>thing! Chanko
hot pot with a huuuge<n>helping of grilled meat! Plus...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Why does it feel like we're<n>celebrating my
birthday instead of<n>yours?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! As long as you keep<n>eating my
food, I'm sure that world<n>peace will be just around
the corner.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
World peace through eating lots of<n>food... Does that
mean I have to eat<n>celery too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's for the sake of the world!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! This won't stop me. After all, a<n>hero can't
choose her battles.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! And just like that, we're one<n>step closer to
world peace! ☆
